Android v5.0.71-mobilev2 (2nd build — activity log, real player skins, MOTD & update fixes)

  • Recent Activity now records server start/stop. Starting and stopping a server adds “Server starting...”, “Server stopping...”, and “Server stopped”/“Server crashed” entries with their own icons, so the activity history reflects what actually happened.
  • Real player skins. Online / Whitelist / Operators / Banned players now show each player’s real Mojang skin head (fetched from sessionserver.mojang.com, per-name mutex dedupe, small in-memory LRU cache) instead of only the pixel-art fallback — matching desktop.
  • MOTD escaping fixed. The server description is written to server.properties correctly escaped (backslash, newline, carriage return) so MOTD text survives instead of breaking the properties file.
  • Update installer no longer crashes the app. Tapping Install on a downloaded update is now wrapped in a robust try/catch — a blocked or missing installer shows a clear message (with an Open in Browser fallback) instead of crashing the app.
  • Stop→Start race fixed. Stopping and immediately restarting no longer leaves the console empty or the server stuck in STARTING; the starting lock is always released via finally and the process-exit cleanup can’t be skipped.

Android v5.0.71-mobilev2 (network rates, storage card, IP display)

  • Upload/Download no longer stuck at 0 B/s. ProcessMonitor used to sum per-interface counters from /proc/net/dev, which reports 0 for these interfaces on many Android devices, so the dashboard always showed 0 B/s. Network rate is now measured per-UID with TrafficStats.getUidRxBytes()/getUidTxBytes() using the server process UID read from /proc/<pid>/status — real up/down throughput on the live stats grid.
  • Storage card added to the dashboard. A live used/total storage card now sits between the performance card and the console preview, mirroring the desktop dashboard.
  • Live IP address on the server card. The home server card now shows the LAN connection address (<localIp>:<port>) whenever the server is running, and “Server not running” otherwise.
  • CPU % rounded. The live stats grid now shows whole-number CPU percentages instead of long decimals.

Android v5.0.70-mobilev2 (Java runtime download fix)

  • Runtime download 404 fixed. The in-app Java runtime install pointed at a wrong file name — openjdk-21.0.12_aarch64.deb instead of the real Termux package openjdk-21_21.0.12_aarch64.deb (Debian names are <package>_<version>_<arch>.deb). Installing the runtime now finds the package on the Termux mirror and succeeds.
  • Fresh installs on arm64/x86_64/arm/x86 all work. The fix applies to every supported ABI since they all share the same filename pattern.

Desktop v5.1.0 hotfix (app won't reopen after restart)

  • App no longer silently fails to start after a reboot. After a restart the custom data directory can be temporarily unavailable (drive not mounted / OneDrive or network path not ready), which made the database driver return null; ServerManager dereferenced it during startup and crashed before any window appeared — no process, no error. The server list now degrades gracefully when the DB can't be opened.
  • Startup errors are never invisible again. Initialization is wrapped in fatalStartup() — any failure writes <dataDir>/startup-error.log and shows an error dialog with the message and log path. An uncaught-exception handler covers crashes anywhere else.
  • Database opens are resilient. The SQLite open retries 3× (2 s apart) with journal_mode=WAL and busy_timeout=5000, so a transiently unavailable data dir recovers instead of hard-failing.
  • Single-instance lock recovered automatically. The lock file now stores the owning PID; a leftover lock from a dead process is cleaned up, and a genuine second launch shows an “already running” dialog pointing at the system tray instead of exiting silently.
  • On-disk log. Logs now append to <dataDir>/portalhost.log so failures leave a trace that survives the process.

Desktop v5.1.0 hotfix (biome-colored world map + player management rework)

  • Biome-colored World Map. The Map tab now paints every generated chunk with its real biome. A new compact NBT binary reader (NbtParser), an Anvil payload decoder (ChunkBiomeReader — gzip/zlib/raw, modern paletted sections[].biomes and legacy Level.Biomes), and a per-region cached decoder (AnvilChunkDecoder) decode .mca chunks off the UI thread. The Terrain toolbar toggle switches between biome colors and the flat region-outline view; ungenerated chunks show as a darker grid; modded/unmapped biomes fall back to neutral gray.
  • Player Management rework. The Online Players tab resolves real Mojang UUIDs (usercache.json first, api.mojang.com fallback) and renders real skin heads from sessionserver.mojang.com (per-UUID dedupe, 429 handled). Each player row gains a ⋯ overflow menu with Kick / Ban / OP / De-OP; clicking the row opens the Player Detail screen.
  • Biome + parser tests. New NbtParserTest, ChunkBiomeReaderTest, and BiomePaletteTest cover NBT primitives/arrays/lists, legacy and modern biome payloads, uncompressed chunks, and the vanilla biome color map. Full desktop suite: 27/27 green.

Desktop v5.1.0 (Player Detail + World Map, hotfixed)

  • Player Detail screen. Click any row in Player Management (Online / Whitelist / Operators / Banned Players) to open a dedicated detail screen with a real Mojang skin bitmap (when online) or pixel-art fallback (when offline or rate-limited), UUID + name copy buttons, first/last seen timestamps derived from usercache.json and console-log join events, and status chips for Online / Whitelisted / Operator (level) / Banned (with reason + expiry).
  • Quick actions on the detail screen. Kick (with optional reason), Ban (with reason — adds to banned-players.json and kicks immediately), OP / De-OP at level 4, Whitelist Add / Remove, and Unban for banned players. All actions are live: file writes go through instantly and snackbar feedback confirms each action.
  • World Map tab. A new Map tab in Server Detail visualizes which chunks have been generated in the world (region outline — Phase A) and overlays live player position markers polled every 3 seconds via RCON (data get entity , Phase D). Pan with drag, zoom 1×-16× per chunk cell, click a chunk to inspect its coordinates. World dir dropdown switches between world, world_nether, and world_the_end.
  • Real Mojang skin integration. New MojangSkinService fetches sessionserver.mojang.com profile JSON with 5 s connect / 10 s read timeouts, a unique PortalHost/5.1.0 User-Agent, per-UUID Mutex dedupe, and graceful handling of 429 responses. SkinRenderCache keeps a two-tier LRU (memory + on-disk PNG with a URL sidecar) so skins persist across launches.
  • Live player positions via RCON. New EntityPositionService reuses the existing RconClient to parse Pos:[x,y,z] from data get entity responses for the World Map’s online markers. 3 s polling cadence matches ProcessMonitor.
  • Region file parsing (no zlib / no NBT). New RegionFileIndex reads only the 4 KiB location table in each r...mca file — 3-byte big-endian offset + 1-byte sector count per chunk, top-bit mark = absent. ChunkDecoder interface plugs in later for biome / terrain colors without changing call sites.
  • Player data layer refactor. PlayerJsonModels (WhitelistEntry / OpEntry / BannedPlayerEntry / BannedIpEntry) moved into commonMain so desktop and Android share the data classes. New PlayerProfileRepository reads usercache.json, normalizes UUIDs to dashed form, and cross-references the existing console_logs SQLite table for first/last seen. PlayerStatusResolver cross-checks whitelist / ops / banlist in one call.
  • Bug fix: Skeleton skin crash. MinecraftHeadIcon.SKIN_COLORS was missing index 9 (Skeleton bone color), causing IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 9 out of bounds for length 9 when a player’s name hash selected the Skeleton variant (1-in-4 chance). Added the missing color and a defensive bounds check.
  • Tests (14 passing). New desktopTest source set with JUnit + Ktor MockEngine: RegionFileIndexTest (synthesized .mca location tables covering all-present, all-absent, mixed), PlayerProfileRepositoryTest (UUID normalization for dashed / undashed / uppercase / invalid), and MojangSkinServiceTest (MockEngine 200 OK + 429 fixtures).
  • Version 5.1.0. Build version bumped to 5.1.0 across Gradle, jpackage, and BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME. User-Agent strings updated to PortalHost/5.1.0.
  • Desktop only. This release ships desktop features only; Android parity is a follow-up.

Hotfix (same v5.1.0 build):

  • Self-update no longer spawns a duplicate process. New SingleInstanceLock acquires a FileChannel.tryLock() on /portalhost.instance.lock at startup and releases it via a JVM shutdown hook. The PowerShell installer now force-kills any lingering PortalHost.exe / portalhost-tagged Java processes, waits 3 s, runs the MSI quietly, waits 5 s more, then starts the new PortalHost.exe — the new process instantly acquires the lock, so a duplicate cannot start.
  • Servers and DB closed before MSI install. The update dialog stops every running server and gives SQLite a brief moment to flush handles before launching the installer, so the MSI can replace portalhost.db and child-process files without lock conflicts.
  • Version display no longer stuck on 5.0.69 after self-update. BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME was hardcoded to 5.0.69 in source. A Gradle task (generateVersionResource) now writes the build version into src/desktopMain/resources/version.txt, and BuildConfig reads it from the classpath at runtime. The MSI bundles version.txt inside the JAR so the title bar / About / Settings all show the real version after install.
  • World Map accuracy. Map rendering now puts world (0,0) at the canvas center, computes the chunk bounding box from the actual loaded regions (with padding), and renders ungenerated areas as a darker grid so chunk boundaries are visible at high zoom. Spawn marker (yellow crosshair) is fixed at chunk (0,0). Player positions use pos.x / pos.z directly (not chunk-rounded), so a player at x=125.3 z=-47.1 lands at the exact sub-chunk location, not the chunk corner. Hit-testing and the player-dot draw loop share the same coordinate transform.
  • Map download location. Update installer no longer writes to user.home; downloads now go to defaultDataDir().

Desktop v5.0.69 (marketplace versions UI)

  • Version cards now match the mobile layout. Each card shows the version title, type chip (RELEASE / BETA), game versions, and the loader + downloads line. Selected cards are tinted with the project accent and get a checkmark.
  • Sticky install bar shows the real filename. When a version is selected, the bottom bar names the file that will be downloaded (e.g. Terralith_1.21.11_v2.6.0.zip) and exposes a single rounded Install button.
  • Project-type-aware loader chip. Datapack projects show a datapack chip next to Game version instead of the generic Loader filter.

Android v5.0.69-mobilev2 (bug fixes + dashboard polish)

  • Server no longer crashes on start (libpthread.so.0 fix). The Java runtime now ships as the Termux-built OpenJDK 21, compiled against Android’s bionic libc, so the JVM runs natively on Android without glibc link errors.
  • Dashboard server card fits narrow phones. The card padding, icon size, status badge, and action buttons were re-sized for Tecno Camon 40 / 360 dp viewports. Server name ellipsizes cleanly and chips no longer overflow.
  • Players card on the dashboard. Mirrors the desktop dashboard — live online players with quick actions and a shortcut to the full Player Management screen.
  • Files tab in Server Details. A new Files tab sits next to Properties and jumps to the existing server file browser.
  • Marketplace Game version filter as a bottom sheet. Tapping the Game version chip now opens the same paginated search sheet used for server software versions.

Android v5.0.69-mobilev2 (in-app updater)

  • Updates install right inside the app. Settings → Check for Updates now downloads the new APK in-app with a live progress dialog (percentage + MB), then hands it to Android’s system installer via FileProvider. No more leaving the app to download from a browser.
  • Robust failure fallback. If the download or the system installer fails, you get a clear error and an “Open in Browser” button that jumps to the APK on the PortalHost site.
  • APK now hosted on the PortalHost site. The Android build is published at portalhost.pages.dev/portalhost-v5.0.69.apk (no GitHub release page in between), and the download page reads the Android URL straight from latest.json.

Android v5.0.69-mobilev2

  • Server software versions fixed on every non-Vanilla type. Rewrote the native Paper, Folia, Purpur, Fabric, and Forge providers to match the desktop endpoints and response shapes (Paper/Folia v3 fill.papermc.io, Fabric meta.fabricmc.net, Forge maven.minecraftforge.net XML, Purpur root API). All six providers now load reliably instead of returning 404/410.
  • Faster version loading. Shorter HTTP timeouts (5–10 s connect/read), no retry on 404/410, a separate fast OkHttp client for version/build fetches capped at 15 s, and a connection warmup to all provider hosts at app start so DNS + TLS are already cached when the wizard opens.
  • Stale-while-revalidate picker. When you tap a server type, cached versions render immediately while the fresh fetch runs in the background. The list never goes blank during reload. Previous fetch jobs are cancelled when you switch types so results can’t race.
  • New version picker UX. Tap the version field to open a Material3 ModalBottomSheet with a sticky search box and a vertically paginated list of versions (10 per page, matching the desktop grid). Empty/no-match state and Prev/Next pagination included.
  • 5-step create-server wizard. Server name + properties (port, gamemode, difficulty, MOTD, icon) are now combined into one screen to match the desktop flow. StepStorageCheck, StepRamConfig, and StepEula are unchanged.
  • Refresh-error hint. When the background fetch fails, the picker shows “Could not refresh versions — showing cached.” so you know the list is stale.
  • Version 5.0.69 parity with desktop. versionCode = 45, versionName = "5.0.69-mobilev2".

Desktop v5.0.69

  • Faster version list loads. HttpCache and URL.readTextWithTimeout now use shorter timeouts (5 s connect / 10 s read) and stop retrying on 404/410 — the URL won’t change between retries, so retrying was pure latency.
  • Connection warmup. DesktopMain warms up DNS + TLS to all provider hosts (fill.papermc.io, meta.fabricmc.net, maven.minecraftforge.net, maven.neoforged.net, api.purpurmc.org, launchermeta.mojang.com) on startup so opening the create-server wizard is instant.
  • Version 5.0.69. Build version bumped to 5.0.69 across Gradle, jpackage, and BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME. User-Agent strings updated to PortalHost/5.0.69.

Android v5.0.68-mobilev2 (2nd build)

  • Server software versions fixed. "No versions available" is gone — version/builds downloads now throw on HTTP errors instead of silently returning empty, and failures surface a clear error message with a Refresh button.
  • Persistent version cache. Fetched versions are cached on disk (5-min TTL) and shown from cache when the API is unreachable, so the picker keeps working offline.
  • JDK install with phases. Java runtime install now reports each phase (connecting, downloading, extracting, verifying) with live progress % and clear failure messages.
  • PortalHost logo parity. The PortalHost logo now appears in-app (header, empty state) and as the launcher icon at every density — matching desktop.
  • Unified notifications. Server status changes (online/crashed/stopped), JDK install results, and add-on install results now show both in-app and as system notifications.

Desktop v5.0.68

  • Uninstaller completely rewritten. Detached batch cleanup kills PortalHost/java processes, force-removes install folder, removes Start Menu shortcuts, and self-deletes. MSI path uses direct msiexec.exe /x (no PowerShell wrapper). Portable/EXE path now also runs full cleanup instead of just exiting.
  • Marketplace detail screen layout fixed. Bottom install bar pinned to window bottom via Scaffold.bottomBar — never cropped. Slim content: tiny accent "✓ Ready" dot + "Ready to install" label + "Install to Server" button. Accent highlight with border when version selected (no more blending).
  • Version cards highlight refined. Subtle 4dp top accent strip + 1dp accent border instead of full background tint. Game versions text ellipsized to 2 lines.
  • Server delete now works. Properly awaits serverManager.deleteServer(), only navigates back on success, shows errors via System.err.
  • Tab clamping. coerceIn prevents "index 9 out of bounds for length 10" crash when server type filters tabs.
  • Folder routing: server-type first. Paper/Purpur/Folia/Vanilla → plugins; Forge/NeoForge/Fabric/Quilt → mods; Datapack always → world/datapacks.

Android v5.0.68-mobilev2

  • Server delete now works. AppState.deleteServer() stops the server if running, removes from repository, deletes server directory recursively, shows confirmation toast.
  • Coroutine/context fixes. Fixed AppState and AppNavigation coroutine scope and LocalContext issues for delete flow.
  • All desktop fixes parity. Folder routing (server-type first), marketplace install folder logic, tab clamping, version card ellipsis.

Desktop v5.0.68

  • Version 5.0.68. versionName = "5.0.68".

Android v5.0.68-mobilev2

  • Console auto-scroll button. The console send button becomes a down-arrow when you scroll up, letting you jump back to the live log at the bottom; it returns to a send icon at the bottom. Removed the oversized floating auto-scroll button.

The activity log now records player commands as <user> execute command: /command, server online/offline transitions, player kills, and kick/ban/op/deop events, each with its own icon and color. Desktop v5.0.66

  • In-app uninstall actually works now. Previously the app launched msiexec then exited immediately via System.exit(0), killing the background thread before it could start the force-remove step — nothing was removed. Now msiexec /x runs elevated with -Wait on a background thread, an "Uninstalling PortalHost..." dialog is shown while it runs, and a detached PowerShell process (which survives app exit) force-removes the install folder once the app closes.
  • Uninstalling never deletes your data. Servers, JDK runtimes, playit tunnels, backups, and the database are moved out of the install folder to %LOCALAPPDATA%\PortalHost before MSI removal (case-insensitive path compare, merge-aware moves, fails-safe abort if the move fails). A pre-start confirmation dialog migrates data directories that were previously stored inside the app image.
  • Windows uninstaller registry lookup fixed. Uninstall.bat now correctly resolves the installed MSI via its UninstallString instead of silently falling back to recursive deletion.
  • Marketplace compatibility fix. Compatibility is now evaluated against the selected version's gameVersions and loaders (new isVersionCompatible()) instead of coarse project-level search data, fixing false "May not be compatible" warnings.
  • Fast JDK 21 installation. Parallel 4-chunk Range-request download with resume, auto-selected fastest mirror (race condition removed), parallel Kotlin ZipFile extraction (~4x faster), hardened archive validation, and detailed progress (size MB, speed MB/s, ETA, chunk index, extracted-file count).
  • Marketplace datapack search & install. Default search returns plugins, mods, and datapacks together; Datapack added as an explicit loader filter; datapacks install to world/datapacks/ with the datapack loader check taking precedence over mod loaders; client-side types (shaders, resourcepacks, modpacks) blocked from server install.
  • Player Management live players. Online tab shows live players from console join/leave events (not stale usercache.json), with Minecraft head icons, Kick/Ban/OP/De-OP action buttons, and join-event dedup.

Android v5.0.66-mobilev2

  • Modrinth Marketplace added (new). Full add-on marketplace: browse plugins, mods, and datapacks with search, filters, sort, and infinite scroll — same fetching and behavior as desktop.
  • Version picker + per-server compatibility. Each project shows its versions; compatibility is checked against the selected version's Minecraft gameVersions and loaders (isVersionCompatible(), matching the desktop fix).
  • Install directly to a server. Downloads the correct file and routes it to plugins/, mods/, or world/datapacks/ based on project type and loaders.
  • Async icon loading via Coil for project thumbnails; replaces the old "Add-ons — Coming Soon" placeholder.
  • Version parity with desktop 5.0.66. versionCode = 42, versionName = "5.0.66-mobilev2".

Desktop v5.0.65

  • Uninstalling PortalHost no longer deletes your data. Uninstalling (from the Settings screen or via Uninstall.bat) now first moves any servers, JDK runtimes, playit tunnels, backups, and the database out of the install folder into %LOCALAPPDATA%\PortalHost, then removes only the program files. The Windows uninstaller registry lookup was fixed — it previously never found the installed MSI and fell back to deleting the whole install folder.
  • Fast JDK 21 installation. Download now uses 4 parallel Range-request chunks with resume support (partial downloads continue where they left off), and the fastest mirror is auto-selected by a latency benchmark at startup. Extraction switched from slow PowerShell Expand-Archive to parallel Kotlin ZipFile extraction (~4x faster). The progress bar now shows exact file size (MB), download speed (MB/s), ETA, chunk index, and extracted-file count across every phase (connecting/downloading/validating/extracting/verifying).
  • Marketplace search defaults to server add-ons. Default search now returns plugins, mods, and datapacks together (OR project_type facet), so searching e.g. terralith finds the datapack instead of only plugins/mods. Added Datapack as an explicit loader filter option.
  • Player Management live players. Online tab now shows live players from console join/leave parsing instead of stale usercache.json. Each player row shows a deterministic Minecraft head icon and action buttons: Kick (/kick), Ban (/ban), OP (/op), De-OP (/deop). Player dedup on join events matches Android behavior.
  • Marketplace datapack routing fixed. Datapacks now install to world/datapacks/ (Minecraft's actual datapack directory) instead of plugins/. Project type checked first: datapack → world/datapacks, resourcepack → resourcepacks, mod with fabric/forge/neoforge/quilt → mods, plugin or paper/spigot/purpur/folia loaders → plugins. Projects with project_type=mod + loaders=[datapack] now correctly route to world/datapacks. Client-side types (shader, resourcepack, modpack) show "Client-side only" and disable the Install button.
  • Navigation fixes. ServerDetailScreen tab sub-screens (Files/Performance/Logs/RCON) pass onBack = { selectedTab = 0 } to return to Properties. ServerFilesScreen smart back button goes up a folder first. PlayerManagementScreen header back button. New RecentActivityScreen with Screen.Activity route; Dashboard "View All" navigates to it.
  • Marketplace install button fixed. Tab content was fillMaxSize() inside a fixed Column, pushing BottomInstallBar off-screen. Wrapped tab content in Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) so the "Install to Server" button is always visible.
  • Logback timing fix verified. Logs land in D:\portalhost\portalhost.log; stale %TEMP%\PortalHost directory no longer recreated.
  • Branding overhaul — green primary + portal violet/cyan accents. Applied AppTheme (green #2E7D32/#81C784, portal violet #7C4DFF/#4A148C, cyan #0097A7/#40C4FF) to desktop. Window titlebar uses MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface (#1E1E1E dark) with square logo + "Portal Host" text.
  • New logo assets. Square portalhost_logo.png (1024×1024 ARGB) for taskbar/alt-tab; horizontal portalhost_wordmark.png (1536×1024) for About screen; portalhost2.ico (16/32/48/64/128 BMP) for installers.
  • Installers rebuilt. PortalHost-5.0.65.msi and PortalHost-5.0.65.exe include all fixes and new branding.

Desktop v5.0.64

  • Fixed: Duplicate server folders upon creation. Creating a server no longer creates both a UUID-based folder and a name-based folder. The UI screens were using File(serversDir, serverId) (UUID path) while ServerManager.getServerDir() resolves to name-based paths. All 20+ occurrences across CreateServerScreen, ServerDetailScreen, DashboardScreen, ServersScreen, ServerFilesScreen, and LogViewerScreen now use the correct name-based directory.
  • Fixed: Marketplace/Add-on browser HTTP 404 with filter changes. httpGet() was reading conn.inputStream before checking the response code, causing an IOException (with the full URL including limit=20) for non-2xx responses instead of reading the error stream. Response code is now checked first, producing clean error messages.
  • Fixed: Legacy UUID folders now cleaned up. Migration from UUID folders to name-based folders now properly deletes source files after copying and removes the UUID folder recursively.
  • Fixed: Marketplace screen used hardcoded ~/.portalhost/servers path. Now uses fileSystem.getServersDirBlocking() to respect the custom data directory setting.
  • Fixed: JVM launch failure (FAILED TO LAUNCH JVM). Found that the stale Java Preferences dataDirectory value (set to PortalHost.exe path) caused the database initialization to fail, crashing the app before launch. The jpackage launcher misleadingly reported "Failed to launch JVM". The actual JVM launched fine — the crash was from the database trying to open at the EXE file path. Cleared stale preference; app now uses default ~/.portalhost/ data directory.
  • Fixed: jlink runtime image missing java.exe. jlink --strip-native-commands removed java.exe from the bundled JRE runtime. Added Gradle... (line truncated to 2000 chars)

Android v5.0.30 — Initial Android Release

  • Full Minecraft Java Edition server manager for Android 7.0+ (API 24)
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with persistent notification showing CPU/RAM/TPS
  • Complete server lifecycle: create, configure, start, stop, restart, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with same server type support as desktop
  • Player management: view online players with ping, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs with add/remove
  • Real-time console with ANSI color support, log level filtering, search, command history, copy/share
  • Performance charts: live CPU%, RAM usage, TPS history graphs with configurable time ranges
  • playit.gg tunnel integration — create public TCP tunnels for server access without port forwarding
  • RCON remote console support with authentication, command sending, response display
  • File management: worlds, plugins, mods, datapacks, backups — upload, download, delete, rename
  • Automatic JDK installation (Adoptium Temurin) with device-appropriate version selection
  • Device-aware RAM/GC configuration — automatically tunes -Xms/-Xmx and GC flags based on available memory
  • Battery optimization exemption request to keep servers running in background
  • Dark/Light theme support with system sync and manual override
  • APK size: ~15 MB (native/PortalHost.apk), package: com.portalhost.app, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36

  • Full migration from Swing/JavaFX to Compose Multiplatform (Kotlin 1.9+, Compose 1.5+)
  • Kotlin Multiplatform project structure: commonMain (shared logic), desktopMain (JVM UI)
  • ServerManager with sanitized folder names (replaces invalid chars: \ / : * ? " < > | with _)
  • Preferences via Multiplatform Settings (DataStore on JVM) — JDK paths, GitHub token, theme, auto-update
  • Dashboard with server cards showing status badge, version, type, memory, port, quick actions
